description: This PHP class defines a console command for managing SQL database migrations within the Goteo project, integrating LibMigration library with Goteo's console system.

classes.name: SqlMigrationCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing SQL migrations in Goteo using LibMigration.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help text.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the configuration array for LibMigration based on Goteo settings.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the migration commands based on user input, such as migrate, create, status, install, etc.
